oracles: oracle self-test: a subject that reports Approved without calling the indicator -> red; a non-approved primitive (e.g. X25519) reported Approved -> red

acceptance.must: tls-subject indicator mode (cmvp): ECDH P-384, ML-KEM-1024 encap/decap, HKDF each Approved via the module indicator; X25519 reported NonApproved (control); 0x11ED handshake reported; oracle in oracles/fips-indicator

notes: Spec-author writes oracles/fips-indicator first in the same unit (red before the subject mode). If the indicator symbols are absent from the release module: INFEASIBLE_REPORT, keep fips-boundary.
